name: SimplyBook.me
summary: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses — booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments.
best_for: service businesses that take appointments and want a booking page, reminders and online payment without building one
skip_if: you only need a simple calendar link for one person — a free scheduling link does that without a booking system on top
honest_knock: The plan ladder is set by bookings per month and by how many custom features you may switch on, and those two ceilings move independently — so you can outgrow a plan on features while nowhere near the booking cap, or the reverse. Free and Basic also carry SimplyBook.me branding on your booking page; white-label starts at Premium.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-16 on simplybook.me/en/pricing, EUR, priceCurrency 'EUR' in the page's own markup) Free EUR 0: 50 bookings a month, 1 custom feature, 1 provider, no card needed. Basic EUR 11.9 a month billed annually or EUR 13.9 monthly: 100 bookings, 3 custom features, 5 providers. Standard EUR 24.9 billed annually or EUR 29.9 monthly: 500 bookings, 8 custom features, 15 providers. Premium EUR 49.9 billed annually or EUR 59.9 monthly: 2,000 bookings, unlimited custom features, 30 providers. Enterprise is custom-priced after a call. Annual billing saves a stated 17%. Their own page says no setup fees, no transaction fees and no per-user charges; payment processors bill their own rates separately. A 14-day trial of premium features runs without a card. Currency note: on 2026-09-20 the same page served the ladder in Brazilian reais to two European networks; on 2026-10-16 it was back in euros, so check the currency on the card before you compare.
